list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT site_label FROM dim_site ORDER BY site_label = 'Ungrouped', site_label

options.content: What has changed since this programme started measuring (**Day 0**, the first day on record): the scorecard, month-by-month Patch Tuesday remediation, and the log of what was found and done. Region figures leave out TEST. Hover the **i** on any panel for exactly what it counts.

panels.description: How long the impact measures have been recorded.

panels.title: Scorecard: Day 0 vs now

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT min(snapshot_date) AS d0, max(snapshot_date) AS d1 FROM daily_impact_metrics), m AS (SELECT metric, sum(value) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date = d.d0) AS b, sum(value) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date = d.d1) AS c FROM daily_impact_metrics, d WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND site_label <> ALL(ARRAY['TEST']) AND snapshot_date IN (d.d0, d.d1) GROUP BY metric), s(ord, label, num, den, good) AS (VALUES (0, 'Servers patched within 35 days', 'servers_patched_35d', 'servers_active', 'up'), (1, 'Servers not patched in 90+ days', 'servers_unpatched_90d', NULL, 'down'), (2, 'Servers not restarted in 35+ days', 'servers_up_35d', NULL, 'down'), (3, 'Domain controllers needing attention', 'dcs_attention', NULL, 'down'), (4, 'Devices with a known-exploited vulnerability', 'hosts_with_kev', 'hosts_active', 'down'), (5, 'Open critical past SLA', 'crit_past_sla', 'crit_open', 'down'), (6, 'Open high past SLA', 'high_past_sla', 'high_open', 'down'), (7, 'Devices on an unsupported OS', 'unsupported_os', NULL, 'down'), (8, 'Machines missing a sensor', 'missing_sensors', NULL, 'down'), (9, 'Sensors silent 7+ days', 'stale_sensors', 'managed_hosts', 'down'), (10, 'Enabled accounts that are stale', 'stale_accounts', 'enabled_accounts', 'down'), (11, 'People without MFA', 'people_no_mfa', NULL, 'down'), (12, 'Unused VPN / remote-app accounts', 'unused_access_accounts', NULL, 'down'), (13, 'Identity detections awaiting triage', 'identity_triage', NULL, 'down'), (14, 'Confirmed external risks open', 'ext_confirmed_open', NULL, 'down'), (15, 'Leaked credentials (enabled accounts)', 'leaked_creds', NULL, 'down')), v AS (SELECT s.ord, s.label, s.good, s.den IS NOT NULL AS rate, CASE WHEN s.den IS NULL THEN n.b ELSE round(100.0 * n.b / NULLIF(dd.b, 0), 1) END AS b, CASE WHEN s.den IS NULL THEN n.c ELSE round(100.0 * n.c / NULLIF(dd.c, 0), 1) END AS c FROM s LEFT JOIN m n ON n.metric = s.num LEFT JOIN m dd ON dd.metric = s.den) SELECT label AS "Measure", CASE WHEN rate THEN b || '%' ELSE to_char(b, 'FM999,999,999') END AS "Day 0", CASE WHEN rate THEN c || '%' ELSE to_char(c, 'FM999,999,999') END AS "Now", CASE WHEN c = b THEN 'no change' ELSE (CASE WHEN c > b THEN '+' ELSE '' END) || CASE WHEN rate THEN round(c - b, 1) || ' pts' ELSE to_char(c - b, 'FM999,999,999') END END AS "Change", CASE WHEN c = b OR c IS NULL OR b IS NULL THEN 'Same' WHEN (c > b) = (good = 'up') THEN 'Better' ELSE 'Worse' END AS "Direction" FROM v ORDER BY ord

panels.description: Each measure on the first day on record (Day 0) and on the latest night, for the selected sites (TEST left out). Rates are worked out from the summed counts. Better/worse follows the direction that's good for that measure.

options.content: Rates from the nightly impact snapshot. A rate can rise just because coverage grew -- read with the scorecard and the cohorts.

panels.title: Servers patched within 35 days

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, round(100.0 * sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'servers_patched_35d') / NULLIF(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'servers_active'), 0), 1) AS "Patched within 35 days" FROM daily_impact_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND site_label <> ALL(ARRAY['TEST']) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Share of active servers whose last confirmed patch is within 35 days.

panels.title: Devices with a known-exploited vulnerability

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, round(100.0 * sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'hosts_with_kev') / NULLIF(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'hosts_active'), 0), 1) AS "Devices with KEV" FROM daily_impact_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND site_label <> ALL(ARRAY['TEST']) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Share of active devices with at least one open CISA KEV finding.

panels.title: Open critical / high past SLA

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, round(100.0 * sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'crit_past_sla') / NULLIF(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'crit_open'), 0), 1) AS "Critical", round(100.0 * sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'high_past_sla') / NULLIF(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'high_open'), 0), 1) AS "High" FROM daily_impact_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND site_label <> ALL(ARRAY['TEST']) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Share of open critical and of open high findings past the remediation SLA.

panels.title: Enabled accounts that are stale

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, round(100.0 * sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'stale_accounts') / NULLIF(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'enabled_accounts'), 0), 1) AS "Stale" FROM daily_impact_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND site_label <> ALL(ARRAY['TEST']) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Share of enabled accounts Falcon Identity flags stale.

panels.title: Backlogs

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'servers_unpatched_90d') AS "Servers not patched 90+ days", sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'identity_triage') AS "Identity detections to triage", sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'ext_confirmed_open') AS "Confirmed external risks", sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'missing_sensors') AS "Machines missing a sensor" FROM daily_impact_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND site_label <> ALL(ARRAY['TEST']) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Counts that should fall: servers not patched in 90+ days, identity detections awaiting triage, confirmed external risks, machines missing a sensor.

options.content: Time to patch, month by month: each cohort is fixed when it starts, so coverage growth can't move it. The first week after release is still collecting (hosts are rescanned).

panels.title: Patch Tuesday cohorts

targets.rawSql: SELECT cohort AS "Patch Tuesday", sum(findings) AS "Findings", sum(hosts) AS "Hosts", round(100.0 * sum(closed_7) / NULLIF(sum(findings) - sum(expired), 0), 1) AS "Fixed in 7 days %", round(100.0 * sum(closed_14) / NULLIF(sum(findings) - sum(expired), 0), 1) AS "14 days %", round(100.0 * sum(closed_30) / NULLIF(sum(findings) - sum(expired), 0), 1) AS "30 days %", round(100.0 * sum(closed_60) / NULLIF(sum(findings) - sum(expired), 0), 1) AS "60 days %", round(100.0 * sum(closed_now) / NULLIF(sum(findings) - sum(expired), 0), 1) AS "Fixed so far %", max(days_elapsed) AS "Days since" FROM patch_cohort_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND site_label <> ALL(ARRAY['TEST']) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.description: Each month's Microsoft findings that appeared in the week after Patch Tuesday on hosts already being assessed, and the share fixed within 7 / 14 / 30 / 60 days (blank until that many days have passed). The comparable, month-on-month measure of time to patch.

panels.title: Action log

targets.rawSql: SELECT found AS "Found", what AS "What was found", source AS "How", site_label AS "Site", severity AS "Severity", action AS "Action", owner_team AS "Owner", status AS "Status", closed AS "Closed", ticket_ref AS "Ticket" FROM impact_actions ORDER BY CASE WHEN status IN ('Done', 'Accepted risk') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, found DESC NULLS LAST

panels.description: From the Impact action log workbook on SharePoint (Metrics > Impact), loaded nightly.
